title: Lodestar Finance — GLP donate() Price Manipulation Attack Analysis
loss_raw: ~$6,500,000 (attacker net profit; platform total loss ~$6.9M per CertiK, QuillAudits, EigenPhi)
root_cause: Donating sGLP directly into the plvGLP vault via the GLP `donate()` function inflates the plvGLP price, enabling an attacker to borrow all assets from Lodestar using the manipulated collateral
